_comment: A deliberately domain-neutral example, used in the prompt pack when the project has no approved mission of its own to show. It demonstrates the SHAPE of a valid mission - semantic targets, a scoped assertion, a machine-checkable check paired with a human statement - without teaching the agent anything about a particular product. Replace nothing here; it is a reference, not a template to copy literally.

requirement_ref.quote: The sentence from the requirement that this mission verifies.

role: A role listed in the application context

starting_context.page: page key from the application context
starting_context.location: where on that page the mission starts

preconditions: State that must already hold. An unmet precondition is BLOCKED, never FAIL.
Record any assumption the mission depends on, so a reviewer can challenge it.
test_objective: One sentence, one objective. If it needs the word 'and', it is probably two missions.

data_policy.cleanup_instruction: How a human removes what this mission created.

actions.instruction: Describe the step in the words a tester would use.

target.description: What the element is, in plain language
target.name: Accessible name exactly as the page exposes it

within.description: Scope it when the same name appears elsewhere on the page

actions.instruction: Enter a run-scoped value so re-runs never collide.

assertions.statement: What a human should read at Gate 1 to judge whether this test is worth approving.

target.description: The element whose presence proves the objective
target.name: QA {run_id}
